sources.title: kubectl-nsenter: target resolution and namespace attachment
sources.version_or_date: Live master-branch README; no dated version established
sources.sections_read: README workflow, restrictions and usage
sources.confirmed: Maps a pod to a node, then uses crictl to resolve container IDs and the target PID before nsenter joins namespaces. It explicitly requires SSH and host tools, with a containerd-related limitation.
sources.limits: Requires SSH, host tools and runtime-specific PID/rootfs details; these must be replaced by an authorized node-agent/CRI path. It supplies no full-spec admission or API audit design. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C03.json.
